documents.title: About SandebTech
documents.content: SandebTech is an engineering consulting company specializing in Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD), marine engineering, digital engineering and simulation-driven product development. We deliver advanced engineering simulation, hydrodynamic optimization and digital engineering solutions for marine, offshore, defense and industrial sectors.

documents.title: Location and Headquarters
documents.content: SandebTech is headquartered in Bangalore, Karnataka, India.

documents.title: Industries Served
documents.content: SandebTech serves Marine and Maritime, Naval Architecture, Defense, Offshore, Heavy Engineering and Turbomachinery sectors, alongside building services and electronics thermal management applications.

documents.title: Pricing and Quotations
documents.content: Project pricing depends on the scope, complexity and engineering effort involved. Contact our team for a customized quotation based on your specific requirements.

documents.title: Software Support and Licensing
documents.content: We provide engineering consulting, implementation, training and support for SHIPFLOW and CAESES software solutions.

documents.title: Book a Meeting
documents.content: You can schedule a technical consultation with our engineering specialists at a time that suits you.

documents.title: Contact SandebTech
documents.content: You can reach SandebTech by email at contact@sandebtech.com, or use the contact page to send your enquiry directly to our engineering team.

documents.title: Hull Form Optimization
documents.content: Optimize vessel hull geometry using Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) to reduce resistance, improve propulsion efficiency and minimize fuel consumption. Capabilities include resistance prediction, hull shape optimization, wave pattern analysis and fuel consumption reduction.

documents.title: Energy Saving Devices Optimization
documents.content: Design and optimize Energy Saving Devices (ESDs) using CFD to improve propulsion efficiency and reduce operational costs. Includes wake improvement, propeller interaction, pre-swirl duct optimization and fuel efficiency analysis.

documents.title: Seakeeping Analysis
documents.content: Evaluate vessel performance in real sea conditions through advanced seakeeping simulations. Services include motion prediction, wave response analysis, operability assessment and performance evaluation.

documents.title: CFD Engineering Consulting
documents.content: Professional CFD consulting services for marine, offshore, industrial and turbomachinery engineering projects including flow simulation, thermal analysis, design validation and engineering consulting.

documents.title: HVAC and Ventilation Simulation
documents.content: Airflow, thermal comfort and ventilation simulation for buildings, cleanrooms and industrial facilities including indoor air quality and energy efficiency analysis.

documents.title: Fire Safety Engineering
documents.content: Performance-based fire and smoke modelling with evacuation analysis including smoke control design, fire dynamics, evacuation analysis and tenability assessment.

documents.title: Electronics Thermal Management
documents.content: Conjugate heat transfer analysis and thermal optimization for electronics, enclosures, data centers and battery systems including heat sink optimization, PCB thermal analysis, liquid cooling and data center cooling.

documents.title: SHIPFLOW CFD
documents.content: SHIPFLOW is a specialized CFD solution for ship resistance prediction, propulsion analysis, self-propulsion simulations and hull optimization.

documents.title: CAESES
documents.content: CAESES is a parametric CAD and design optimization platform enabling automated engineering workflows and CFD-driven optimization.

documents.title: Lotus Marine
documents.content: Lotus Marine delivers advanced marine engineering solutions for offshore structures, vessel dynamics and seakeeping analysis.

documents.title: Turbomachinery
documents.content: Advanced turbomachinery simulation and optimization for pumps, compressors, turbines and rotating equipment.
